about.title: HOT N COOL
about.subtitle: The coolest place for the hottest food in town
about.heading: Our Story
about.description:
Hot N Cool has established itself as a premier restaurant chain in Qatar, offering a distinctive fusion of traditional flavors and innovative culinary experiences. Founded in the early 1990s, we have expanded to over 68 outlets across the country, earning a strong reputation in the hospitality industry.

With an unwavering commitment to excellence, we deliver outstanding service and high-quality meals, fostering a loyal customer base. Our restaurants provide a warm and inviting atmosphere where guests can enjoy a diverse range of freshly prepared dishes, from classic Middle Eastern recipes to contemporary creations.

As part of the HNC Group, we also manage OOREGOO Factory, a subsidiary that produces and distributes premium frozen, chilled, and fresh food products across the Middle East. Our factory is ISO 22000:2018 and HACCP compliant, ensuring the highest standards of food safety.

Additionally, our Catering Division provides a comprehensive range of services, including corporate catering, buffet services, outdoor catering, and on-site catering for schools, universities, and government entities.

chairmanMessage.name: Nizar Abdullah
chairmanMessage.role: Chairman & Managing Director, HNC Group of companies
chairmanMessage.title: Chairman's Message
chairmanMessage.p1: In the heart of Qatar, 1991 became the first chapter of a dream served with passion and hustle. With nothing but determination and endless passion, Nizaar Abdulla & team stepped into the world of hospitality by assisting with small responsibilities inside a cafeteria. But with passion to learn, he slowly mastered every part of the work — from making to understanding the true spirit of hospitality.
chairmanMessage.p2: Through years of dedication and sacrifice, that small beginning turned into something extraordinary. One simple idea — keeping the shop partially open at night — later became the start of a 24-hour restaurant loved by countless people.
chairmanMessage.p3: Today, HotnCool Restaurant holds a special place in the hearts of many, especially within the Arab community across the UAE and Qatar. With 72+ branches, 1000+ employees, and 200+ vehicles under the brand, it stands today as a symbol of trust, taste, and consistency.

valuableReality.title: VALUABLE REALITY
valuableReality.heading:
What We
Stand For
valuableReality.body:
At Hot n Cool, we believe in quality, responsibility, and care. We serve fresh, high-quality meals while minimizing waste through thoughtful menu planning.
Built on trust, honesty, and integrity, we stand by our commitments and give back to the community through charitable initiatives.
More than good food – we serve with purpose.
valuableReality.p1: At Hot n Cool, we believe true value is built on principles quality, responsibility, and care. It's not just about serving food it's about doing things the right way, every step of the journey.
valuableReality.p2: We focus on delivering high quality meals prepared with fresh ingredients and genuine attention to detail. To reduce waste and respect our resources, we customize each menu based on individual needs ensuring satisfaction without excess.
valuableReality.p3: Our foundation is built on trust, honesty, and integrity. We don't just say the right words we follow through with real actions, standing by our commitments every day.
valuableReality.p4: We also believe in giving back. A portion of our profits goes toward charitable causes, because success means more when it's shared with those who need it most.
valuableReality.p5: This is what we stand for. Not just good food, but a greater purpose. At Hot n Cool, values aren't just spoken they're lived.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body:
Our mission is to take the rich flavours of Asia and the Arab world to the rest of the world, making great food, tea, and hospitality accessible to everyone. Inspired by the way coffee became a global culture, we believe tea, traditional flavours, and regional cuisine can travel just as far. Through our restaurants, delivery, catering, and food production, we combine authentic flavours with modern hospitality, consistency, innovation, and quality.
We don’t just serve food. We take flavours, culture, and hospitality beyond borders.
mission.text:
Our mission is to offer an unparalleled dining experience by providing a diverse selection of high quality dishes, blending traditional flavors with a modern twist. We are committed to using the freshest ingredients, adhering to strict cleanliness and safety standards, and maintaining professionalism and integrity across all operations.

Through continuous innovation, we strive to exceed our patrons' expectations and deliver unforgettable culinary moments.

Through OOREGOO Factory, we extend our mission by offering premium food products and catering services that adhere to international standards, serving schools, universities, and government organizations.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body:
To become a globally recognised food and hospitality brand from Qatar, bringing the flavours, tea, cuisine, and hospitality of Asia and the Arab world to people around the world by blending authentic flavours with innovative cuisine.
We aspire to build a brand that crosses borders, connects cultures, and makes regional flavours part of the global dining experience, while staying rooted in our values, heritage, and commitment to quality.
vision.text:
Our vision at Hot N Cool is to be globally recognized as a leader in culinary excellence.

We aspire to blend authentic traditional flavors with innovative culinary techniques in an ambiance that promotes comfort and sophistication.

Every customer interaction should be a celebration of high quality food, exceptional service, and memorable experiences.

Our goal is to expand our brand presence and reach more customers worldwide.

intro.label: Careers at Hot N Cool
intro.heading:
Build Your Career
With Us
intro.body1: Hot N Cool has been part of daily life in Qatar since 1991, and every plate that leaves our kitchens is the work of a team that takes pride in it. From our restaurants and kitchens to delivery and the support office, our people are the reason guests keep coming back.
intro.body2: We are always glad to meet people who care about hospitality — whether you are starting your first job or bringing years of kitchen experience with you. Tell us where you see yourself fitting in, and we will take it from there.

why.label: Why Work With Us?
why.heading:
A Place Worth
Staying For
why.intro: We ask a lot of our teams, so we try to give a lot back: clear expectations, people who look out for each other, and a real path forward for anyone who wants one.

culture.title: A Culture of Respect
culture.text: Everyone from the kitchen line to the front counter is spoken to the same way. Good work is noticed and problems are raised early, not stored up.

teamwork.title: Teamwork First
teamwork.text: A busy service only works when the whole shift moves together. We hire for people who cover for a colleague without being asked.

growth.title: Room to Grow
growth.text: Many of our supervisors and branch leads started on the floor. When a role opens, we look inside the team before we look outside it.

learning.title: Learning on the Job
learning.text: New joiners are paired with an experienced colleague and trained on our recipes, service standards, hygiene rules and safety procedures.

development.title: Career Development
development.text: We talk with you about where you want to be next and what it will take to get there, rather than leaving it to chance.

recognition.title: Recognition for Effort
recognition.text: Long hours during a rush do not go unnoticed. Effort and reliability count towards the roles that open up next.

life.label: Life at Hot N Cool
life.heading:
More Than
a Shift
life.body1: Our restaurants are busy, social places, and the teams inside them are the same. Shifts are planned so nobody is left carrying a service alone, and a new joiner always has someone to ask.
life.body2: Outside service hours our teams meet across branches — for training sessions, for celebrations and for the sport and community events we take part in around Qatar.

p1.title: A team that mixes
p1.text: Colleagues from many backgrounds working one floor, one kitchen, one standard.

p2.title: Branches across Qatar
p2.text: Work close to home — our branches are listed on the Find Us page.

p3.title: Real responsibility
p3.text: You are trusted with your section from the day your training ends.

story.heading:
From a Small Beginning
to a Growing Legacy
story.left:
In 1991, in the heart of Qatar, Nizar Abdullah and his team began a journey with little more than passion, hard work, and a determination to learn. Starting with a small cafeteria, they learned every part of the business — from the kitchen to service, delivery, and customer care.

Then came a simple idea: why not be there when customers need us most? Keeping the cafeteria open late gradually led to a 24-hour concept, creating a destination where customers could enjoy their favourite food, even in the middle of the night.
story.right:
That small beginning grew into Hot N Cool — a trusted hospitality brand with 70+ branches, 1,000+ employees, and 200+ vehicles across Qatar and the UAE.

Through every stage of growth, one thing has remained unchanged: our passion for hospitality, our commitment to consistency, and the trust of our customers.
